scripts.wp:plugin:activate: wp-env run cli wp plugin activate spintax
scripts.wp:plugin:deactivate: wp-env run cli wp plugin deactivate spintax
scripts.wp:db:reset: wp-env run cli wp db reset --yes
scripts.test:php:setup: wp-env run tests-cli -- bash -c "cd /tmp && composer require --dev --no-interaction yoast/phpunit-polyfills:^2.0 phpunit/phpunit:^9.6 && composer config allow-plugins.dealerdirect/phpcodesniffer-composer-installer true && composer require --dev --no-interaction squizlabs/php_codesniffer:^3.7 wp-coding-standards/wpcs:^3.0 dealerdirect/phpcodesniffer-composer-installer:^1.0 2>&1"
